title: Brain Machine Meditation
author: Mitch Altman
description: The sequence starts with lots of Beta (awake / conscious), which is where most people will be when they begin. Then Alpha waves (dreamy / trancy) are added, to connect with subconscious Theta that will be coming up. Then the Beta is reduced (for less conscious, making it easier to be move more into a trance). Then some Theta (more subconscious) is added, and in the middle, there are some pulses of Delta (creativity). Then the sequence is reversed, to come back up, nice and refreshed.

title: Brain Machine Sleep
author: Mitch Altman
description: The sleep sequence starts out the same as the meditation sequence, but then keeps the brainwave frequencies at mostly Theta waves, with a little bit of Alpha, and with some pusling Delta.  This is enough to get you to drift off to sleep.

title: Brain Machine Gamma
author: Mitch Altman
description: Plays Gamma waves (40.0 Hz) for one hour.
